newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Kabila expected in Kisangani.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Kabila expected in Kisangani.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila was expected in the newly captured city of Kisangani on Friday and residents were lining the streets to greet him, a senior rebel official and witnesses said.
"The president (Kabila) is coming and is due to land at the airport in town (around 0715 GMT)," rebel finance commissioner Mawampanga Mwana Nanga told Reuters.
Many youths headed to the airport to greet Kabila while others lined the streets of town, witnesses said. Kisangani's youth have been awaiting the arrival of the man many describe as a liberator.
Kabila's Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire (ADFL) is in control of around a fifth of Zaire.
